definitions.gloss: self-serving; drawing water to one's own rice field
definitions.explanation: Acting in one's own interest; interpreting situations to one's own advantage; being self-serving in arguments or actions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{我田引水|がでんいんすい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{我田引水|がでんいんすい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: Please don't interpret things to suit your own interests.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{我田引水|がでんいんすい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: That paper has many self-serving arguments.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {我|が} (my/one's own) + {田|でん} (rice field) + {引|いん} (draw/pull) + {水|すい} (water). The image is of a farmer diverting irrigation water to their own field, leaving less for neighbors.

USAGE: Used to criticize someone for being self-serving, biased, or interpreting facts to favor themselves. Often used as a na-adjective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {我田引水|がでんいんすい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (a self-serving opinion)
- {我田引水|がでんいんすい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧ (a self-serving interpretation)
- {我田引水|がでんいんすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think in a self-serving way)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自分勝手|じぶんかって}→自分勝手：19490_jibunkatte⟧ (selfish)
- ⟦{手前味噌|てまえみそ}→手前味噌：28919_temaemiso⟧ (self-praise, tooting one's own horn)
- ⟦{利己的|りこてき}→利己的：21285_rikoteki⟧ (selfish, egotistical)
